# LinkedIn
> Professional networking platform for identity, connections, jobs, learning, publishing, and business insights.

LinkedIn helps people build professional profiles, grow networks, discover jobs, learn skills, publish content, and connect with companies, recruiters, and industry communities.

## Core Platform
- [Home](https://www.linkedin.com/): Main entry point for LinkedIn’s professional networking platform.
- [Login](https://www.linkedin.com/login): Sign in to access your LinkedIn account and network.
- [Sign Up](https://www.linkedin.com/signup): Create a new LinkedIn account and professional profile.
- [Feed](https://www.linkedin.com/feed/): Personalized stream of professional updates, posts, and conversations.
- [My Network](https://www.linkedin.com/mynetwork/): Manage connections, invitations, and professional relationship recommendations.
- [Messaging](https://www.linkedin.com/messaging/): Communicate with connections, recruiters, and colleagues through LinkedIn messages.

## Profiles, People, and Networking
- [People Directory](https://www.linkedin.com/pub/dir/+/+): Search LinkedIn’s public directory of people and professionals.
- [Profile Search](https://www.linkedin.com/search/results/people/): Find people by name, company, title, or location.
- [Companies Search](https://www.linkedin.com/search/results/companies/): Search for companies and organization pages on LinkedIn.
- [Groups Search](https://www.linkedin.com/search/results/groups/): Discover professional groups and communities by topic or industry.
- [Events Search](https://www.linkedin.com/search/results/events/): Find professional events, webinars, and networking opportunities.
- [Hashtags Search](https://www.linkedin.com/search/results/all/?keywords=%23): Explore topics and conversations organized by hashtag.

## Jobs and Hiring
- [Jobs](https://www.linkedin.com/jobs/): Browse job listings, recommendations, and career opportunities.
- [Job Search](https://www.linkedin.com/jobs/search): Search for jobs by title, company, skill, or location.
- [Easy Apply Jobs](https://www.linkedin.com/jobs/search/?f_AL=true): Find jobs that support streamlined LinkedIn applications.
- [Internship Jobs](https://www.linkedin.com/jobs/internships/): Explore internship opportunities for students and early-career professionals.
- [Post a Job](https://www.linkedin.com/talent/post-a-job): Create and publish job listings for candidates on LinkedIn.
- [Open to Work](https://www.linkedin.com/help/linkedin/answer/a507508): Learn how to signal job-seeking status to recruiters.

## Learning and Skill Development
- [LinkedIn Learning](https://www.linkedin.com/learning/): Online learning platform for business, technology, and creative skills.
- [Learning Search](https://www.linkedin.com/learning/search): Search courses, learning paths, and expert-led training content.
- [Learning Topics](https://www.linkedin.com/learning/topics): Browse LinkedIn Learning topics by subject area.
- [Certifications Preparation](https://www.linkedin.com/learning/cert-prep): Prepare for professional certification exams with guided courses.
- [Learning for Organizations](https://learning.linkedin.com/): Explore LinkedIn Learning solutions for teams and enterprises.

## Content, Publishing, and News
- [Top Content](https://www.linkedin.com/top-content): Curated professional content and trending LinkedIn topics.
- [News](https://www.linkedin.com/news/): Read professional news, industry coverage, and editorial content.
- [Articles](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/): Long-form professional articles and publishing on LinkedIn.
- [Newsletter Directory](https://www.linkedin.com/newsletters/): Discover newsletters from creators, executives, and publishers.
- [Collaborative Articles](https://www.linkedin.com/advice/): Community-driven expert articles and professional advice.
- [Creator Tools](https://www.linkedin.com/help/linkedin/answer/a543663): Learn about features for publishing and audience growth.

## Business, Sales, and Recruiting Solutions
- [Talent Solutions](https://business.linkedin.com/talent-solutions): Recruiting and hiring products for employers and talent teams.
- [Marketing Solutions](https://business.linkedin.com/marketing-solutions): Advertising and brand tools for reaching professional audiences.
- [Sales Solutions](https://business.linkedin.com/sales-solutions): Sales intelligence and prospecting tools for revenue teams.
- [Learning Solutions](https://business.linkedin.com/learning-solutions): Workplace learning products for employee development and upskilling.
- [Business Solutions](https://business.linkedin.com/): Overview of LinkedIn products for hiring, marketing, sales, and learning.
- [LinkedIn Ads](https://www.linkedin.com/campaignmanager/): Manage advertising campaigns targeting LinkedIn’s professional audience.

## Company Pages and Insights
- [Company Pages](https://www.linkedin.com/company/): Access LinkedIn company page URLs and organization presence.
- [Top Companies](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/topics/home/): Explore professional topics and publisher ecosystems on LinkedIn.
- [Salary](https://www.linkedin.com/salary/): Research compensation insights by role, company, and location.
- [Services Marketplace](https://www.linkedin.com/services/): Find and offer professional services through LinkedIn.
- [Products](https://www.linkedin.com/products/): Discover software tools and product recommendations on LinkedIn.

## Games and Engagement
- [LinkedIn Games](https://www.linkedin.com/games): Play LinkedIn’s professional puzzle and word games.
- [Queens](https://www.linkedin.com/games/queens/): Play the Queens logic puzzle on LinkedIn.
- [Pinpoint](https://www.linkedin.com/games/pinpoint/): Play LinkedIn’s category-based word association game.
- [Crossclimb](https://www.linkedin.com/games/crossclimb/): Solve LinkedIn’s vocabulary and ladder-style word puzzle.
- [Tango](https://www.linkedin.com/games/tango/): Play LinkedIn’s pattern and logic-based puzzle game.

## Help, Safety, and Policies
- [Help Center](https://www.linkedin.com/help/linkedin): Official support articles for using LinkedIn features and settings.
- [Professional Community Policies](https://www.linkedin.com/help/linkedin/answer/a1340407): Review rules governing behavior and content on LinkedIn.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.linkedin.com/legal/privacy-policy): Understand how LinkedIn collects, uses, and shares personal data.
- [User Agreement](https://www.linkedin.com/legal/user-agreement): Terms governing use of LinkedIn services and platform features.
- [Cookie Policy](https://www.linkedin.com/legal/cookie-policy): Learn how LinkedIn uses cookies and similar technologies.
- [Safety Center](https://www.linkedin.com/safety): Resources for account security, trust, and platform safety.

## Developers and Engineering
- [LinkedIn Engineering](https://engineering.linkedin.com/): Engineering blog covering infrastructure, AI, data, and product systems.
- [LinkedIn API Program](https://learn.microsoft.com/linkedin/): Developer documentation for LinkedIn APIs and integrations.
- [Marketing Developer Platform](https://learn.microsoft.com/linkedin/marketing/): Documentation for LinkedIn marketing APIs and campaign integrations.
- [Talent Solutions API](https://learn.microsoft.com/linkedin/talent/): Developer resources for recruiting and talent integrations.
- [Sales Navigator API](https://learn.microsoft.com/linkedin/sales/): Documentation for sales-related LinkedIn developer capabilities.

## About and Corporate
- [About LinkedIn](https://about.linkedin.com/): Corporate information about LinkedIn’s mission, products, and company.
- [Careers](https://careers.linkedin.com/): Explore jobs and career opportunities at LinkedIn.
- [Pressroom](https://news.linkedin.com/): Company news, announcements, and media resources.
- [Economic Graph](https://economicgraph.linkedin.com/): Research and insights on labor markets, skills, and economic trends.
- [Transparency Center](https://transparency.linkedin.com/): Reports and policies related to trust, safety, and platform governance.
